name: Sharpie Mini Permanent Markers with Keychain Clips (5 Pack)
seoTitle: Sharpie Mini Markers with Clips for Nurses
metaDescription: A five pack of black Sharpie mini permanent markers with keychain clips that hook onto a badge reel or lanyard. A small, useful gift for busy nurses.
summary: Five black Sharpie mini markers with keychain clips, a tiny, useful gift for nurses who are always reaching for something to write with.
whyItWorks: Nurses write on everything: tape, labels, whiteboards, specimen bags, even their own hands when paper is out of reach. A marker that clips onto a lanyard, badge reel, or scrub pocket is always there when a pen goes missing, which happens constantly on a busy unit. The mini size keeps it from crowding pockets already stuffed with alcohol wipes, a penlight, trauma shears, and a phone.

Sharpie is a familiar name at the nurses station, and a five pack means she can keep one on her badge, one in her bag, one in her locker, and still share with a coworker. It is an easy stocking stuffer, a great add in for a nursing student clinical kit, or a handful to tuck into Nurses Week goodie bags for the whole unit. Add a fun badge reel and the gift feels complete.
goodToKnow: These are black, fine point permanent markers, so be careful around scrubs and lab coats.
Check the listing for how the keychain clip attaches to a badge reel or lanyard.
Pair with a badge reel or penlight for a small practical bundle.

faq.q: Why would a nurse want mini Sharpies?
faq.a: Nurses label and write on a lot of things during a shift, and a clipped marker is hard to lose. The small size fits on a badge or lanyard without getting in the way.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for nursing students?
faq.a: Yes, students can clip one to their clinical badge and keep spares in their bag. It is a handy add in for a clinical supply kit.
